messages:
anya: quick question — when we save a query from the per-route console, should the saved query inherit the route + any model pins automatically, or should it only capture the route and leave model pins out? i'm worried about people hitting quota previews that don't match what they actually run.

sam: leaning toward inheritance of model pins for UX simplicity (so a saved query reproduces the view). but agree quota preview could be confusing if we change model later.

mira: from the API side, we can make saved queries store an explicit `pinned_models` array and a `pin_mode` flag (`inherit` | `snapshot`). default = `snapshot` would lock the model ids at save time. cheap to add field; harder to change UX later.

jordan: UX note — users expect "Save view" to reproduce what they see. if we store pins by default that's consistent. but we should show a callout in the save modal: "Includes pinned models — changes to model pinning won't update this saved query unless you edit it." small copy + subtle badge solves a lot. :memo:

luis: telemetry/rollout concern: if saved queries inherit and models drift we'll start seeing saved-query->route metric divergence. we should emit an event `saved_query.resolve` on load that includes resolved model ids and sample rate so console telemetry ties cost previews to what actually executed.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: consolesave-v2 -> canary at 2pm UTC.

anya: proposal: 1) API: saved query object includes `scope` (route|global), `pinned_models` (array), `pin_mode` (snapshot|inherit). 2) UX: default to `snapshot` for safety but add checkbox "Include current pinned models" default checked when saving from route view. 3) Telemetry: emit `saved_query.preview` with resolved models + sample rate whenever preview/quota calculation runs. 4) Rollout: canary console save modal change behind feature flag.

sam: implementation notes: backend will accept `pin_mode`, if `inherit` we store an empty pinned_models and resolve on-read. preview service will need to call model-resolver and include resolution in quota calc. ETA: 2 sprints for backend + 1 sprint for preview service adapter.

mira: small API snippet for saved query payload: 
```json
{"scope":"route","route_id":"rt_123","pin_mode":"snapshot","pinned_models":["rwd-gpt-7b-q4"],"filters":{"status":["prod"]}}
```

jordan: also suggest small UX affordance: when a saved query is shown in list, show a tiny model-pill cluster if it has pinned models, with tooltip "pins snapshot at save time". reduces surprise.

luis: for telemetry sampling: we should tag saved-query preview events with `telemetry_sample_rate` and `compute_tier` so cost previews are comparable across users. put a gate for telemetry retention (opt-in) per team.

anya: sounds like we're converging. decision check: default = snapshot (safer), checkbox to include pins, emit preview telemetry. anyone object?

sam: +1

mira: +1

jordan: +1 :thumbsup:

luis: +1 — will draft telemetry schema.

anya: ok i'll write a short RFC with API contract and mock modal copy and tag people. thanks. :raised_hands:
